articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring dramatically improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science questions and complex coding tasks, with the model demonstrating emergent planning capabilities that narrow the gap toward general-purpose AI agents.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra set new records on SWE-Bench Verified and HumanEval-Plus, solving over 75% of real-world GitHub issues autonomously. The model introduces a novel hierarchical planning architecture that decomposes multi-file refactoring tasks, making it a strong contender for production-grade AI software engineering workflows.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Commercial Atlas Electric for Warehouse and Manufacturing Deployment
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics announced general availability of the fully electric Atlas humanoid robot for industrial partners, featuring improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and real-time vision-language model integration for task instruction. Early deployments at Hyundai and Amazon fulfillment centers show the robot can autonomously handle irregular package sorting at near-human throughput.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C, Demos Figure 03 Performing Multi-Step Assembly Tasks
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a massive $1.5 billion funding round at a $15 billion valuation, demonstrating its Figure 03 humanoid robot performing complex electronics assembly with tool use. The robot leverages an on-device vision-language-action model fine-tuned on factory teleoperation data, achieving sub-centimeter precision in pick-and-place sequences without pre-programmed waypoints.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Computer Use 2.0 with Persistent Memory and Multi-App Orchestration
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major update to Claude's computer use capabilities, now supporting persistent session memory across tasks and coordinated workflows spanning multiple desktop applications. The system can reliably complete multi-hour administrative workflows like data reconciliation across spreadsheets and CRM systems, marking a significant step toward practical AI office automation.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production of its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Kaohsiung fab, with initial wafers destined for Apple and NVIDIA's next-generation AI training chips. The node delivers a 25% power efficiency improvement over N2, enabling data center GPUs to push past 2 petaflops of FP8 throughput per chip while staying within existing thermal envelopes.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained fault-tolerant operations on 12 logical qubits with error rates below the threshold needed for practical quantum error correction. Using Microsoft's new qubit virtualization layer on Quantinuum's H3 trapped-ion system, the team executed 50-round syndrome extraction circuits, a prerequisite for running commercially relevant quantum algorithms at scale.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office commenced its first formal compliance audits of general-purpose AI model providers under the AI Act's Chapter V obligations, with OpenAI, Google, and Meta among the initial targets. The audits focus on systemic risk assessments, red-teaming documentation, and energy consumption reporting, setting precedents that will shape global AI governance frameworks.
